summary: 26-year-old male snowboarder crashed into a tree on the Jolly Jug Trail at Eldora Mountain Resort ~3:50 p.m. Sunday; BCSO, ski patrol and Northern Colorado MedEvac rescue personnel transported him to the first-aid room; pronounced dead ~4:40 p.m.; bystander CPR before rescuers arrived; helmet worn
location: Jolly Jug Trail, Eldora Mountain Resort
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Eldora ski patrol; Northern Colorado MedEvac
notes: One of two Eldora tree-collision fatalities the same weekend (companion: 2021-03-01 Lower Ambush).
